statement: The native call-context contract is sealed as an architecture owner-boundary contract: architecture/minimal-deployment-surface.md names the lagrange:cell/call-context WIT interface as the sole public call/pushdown invocation surface and extends the call Binding schema-v2 source contract with an optional declared partition-local statement (create-only; legacy {kind,name} bindings remain valid but non-invocable), and the four epic open questions are resolved with recorded decisions — pushdown binds the declared statement itself as the invocation within the same call-cell world, reduce runs on any replica under lease with an exactly-once visible final snapshot, the u32 capability probe is dropped from the contract until the typed enum exists, and the per-run batch memory bound is a Binding-declared budget with a typed budget-exhausted refusal — with the epic, the ABI fixture WIT, and the call-cell guard scenario updated to match and green, and no runtime invocation mechanism introduced.
